The average length of hospice care differs by population and year: for Medicare decedents enrolled in hospice in 2021 the average was 92.1 days [d2], and in 2022 the U.S. Medicare average was 95.3 days [d7]. Earlier national figures reported averages around 76–78 days [d1,d5,d6]. Across sources, medians are much shorter (about 17 days), reflecting that many patients have very brief stays while a minority remain for six months or longer [d2,d3,d4].
